subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Utilizar, ao produzir texto, conhecimentos linguísticos e gramaticais: modos e tempos verbais, concordância nominal e verbal, pontuação etc.

components.description_pt: Aplicar modos e tempos verbais apropriados em textos de autoria própria
components.description_en: Apply appropriate verbal moods and tenses in self-produced texts
components.cc_component_description: Form and use verbs in the indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive moods

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras de concordância nominal e verbal na produção de textos
components.description_en: Apply nominal and verbal agreement rules in text production
components.cc_component_description: Apply subject-verb agreement rules in complex sentence structures

components.description_pt: Usar convenções de pontuação corretamente, incluindo vírgulas, ponto-e-vírgula e reticências, na escrita
components.description_en: Use punctuation conventions correctly, including commas, semicolons, and ellipses, in writing
components.cc_component_description: Use punctuation conventions correctly, including commas, semicolons, and ellipses, in writing

cc_matches.description: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
